label: D (arithmetic on measured M3 bundles)
scope: native proofs of the 15 M3 scale-up runs (bundle.json declarations). Rows = 2^log per component per proof; today every component is already padded to its own power of two, so 'tax' is the extra padded rows a canonical rung set would add on top of today's pow2 padding. Width-agnostic (each component's tax is width-independent within a family; family/all aggregates weight components by rows, NOT cells).
